subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should #100121 remain the umbrella for the combined placeholder plus no-reply tool-error contract, or should maintainers split it behind narrower placeholder, warning-policy, and incomplete-turn items?
rationale: Current main has fixed part of the placeholder behavior, but the remaining source branches affect user-visible warning noise and terminal-turn semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Keep umbrella until contract lands
options.body: Keep #100121 open until related placeholder work lands and maintainers choose the warning/fallback behavior for read-only exec failures with no reply.

options.title: Split into canonical follow-ups
options.body: Move the remaining work to separate placeholder, exec-warning, and incomplete-turn issues, then close #100121 only after those links are explicit.

options.title: Close after live beta confirmation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the shipped beta behavior resolves the user problem and no separate warning/fallback policy change is needed.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella until contract lands
recommendation.body: Keep #100121 open until related placeholder work lands and maintainers choose the warning/fallback behavior for read-only exec failures with no reply.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged history in the terminal-classifier area that controls the incomplete-turn side of the behavior decision.
